The age old question lol.

idc which you like more, i just wanna know what the main differences are. i've done acid a couple times and *loooooove* it. i'm planning on doing shrooms this weekend for the first time and wanna know what to expect.

also, obligatory noob questions: how much should we take, what do i do if i feel like i'm having a bad trip, do they really taste *that* bad?

Acid over shrooms, every day. The quality of the trip is much, much better.

Since you know what it feels like to trip, you'll probably be OK. It's much the same feeling, with the notable exception of how your stomach reacts. Mushrooms are poisonous, that's what you see when you eat them. You're watching the poison affect your body. Your stomach doesn't like this, and you could become nauseas. Start slowly. Buy an 1/8th per person, at most, but don't take it all at once. I'd recommend half, so you can get used to the feeling. Also, compared to the length of the acid trips I've had, be ready to trip for noticeably longer.

If you feel like you're having a bad trip, you've already fucked up. You need to go into it with that same mindset of acid and try to have fun. Once you start on the "omg I'm having a bad trip" road the only thing that can get you out of it is yourself. Just do your best to remember that it's not real. Not the easiest thing, but it's possible and it's helped me calm down before. I'd recommend having a somewhat sober friend with you, and do it outside in a big park/forest type place in daylight. That'll help keep the demons at bay.

As to the taste... Yeah. They taste like ass. Chop them up, put them in a PB sandwich or something and you'll hardly notice though.

Good luck. Hope you have fun.

Shrooms are cool. It is a common misconception that the mushrooms are poisoning you to produce the trip. That is entirely false. The side effects that are commonly associated with the believe that psilocybe mushrooms are poisoning you (nausea, fatigue, muscle weakness) are mild and easily combated with marijuana.

Mushroom trips tend to be milder than LSD, where LSD can actually distort reality (making you see and hear things that are not there), mushrooms really just intensify the environment you're already in. Mushrooms affect the body more than LSD, which generally affects the brain directly. Both use the central nervous system.

I love mushrooms! They are "earthier" than LSD, making you focus on your environment and body more than LSD would. I end doing gymnastic shit when I'm tripping shrooms, where when I trip acid I'm all insightful and philosophical and shit.

The dose mentioned earlier is cool, but I would take them in 1-2 gram doses until you reach your comfort level. Beginners should not do more than an 1/8 ounce unless they fell okay doing it.

Happy Shrooming!
